items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying the first seven axioms the degree of the unit of the spectrum of a finite Galois extension is the degree of the extension (statement lines 5063-5068). The proof (proof lines 5069-5100) decomposes the diagonal of the product of the extension into the graphs of the automorphisms, applies the defining map of the degree, and counts. H2: a complete short computation.
